article.title: Winding up by Tribunal.
article.content:
2701[Winding up by Tribunal.

Section 270  ·  Chapter XX  ·  page 169 of the Act
The provisions of Part I shall apply to the winding up of a company by the Tribunal under this Act.]
1 Subs. by Act 31 of 2016, s. 255 and the Eleventh Schedule, for section 270 (w.e.f. 15-11-2016).
